(ਅਜੇਹੇ ਬੰਦੇ) ਹਰ ਰੋਜ਼ ਇਉਂ ਵਿਲਕਦੇ ਹਨ ਜਿਵੇਂ ਸੁੰਞੇ ਘਰਾਂ ਵਿਚ ਕਾਂ ਲੌਂਦਾ ਹੈ (ਪਰ ਓਥੋਂ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਮਿਲਦਾ ਕੁਝ ਨਹੀਂ) ।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":1984,"next":1986}}
files.shabads/3/1986.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":1986,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":9,"page_no":522,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":3,"first_verse_id":23223,"last_verse_id":23225,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Gujri","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਗੂਜਰੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":23223,"page_no":522,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"ਮਃ ੫ ॥","translit_en":"mahalaa panjavaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Fifth Mehla:","ms":"5th Guru."}}},{"verse_id":23224,"page_no":522,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"ਪਿਰੀ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਜਾ ਥੀਐ ਸਾਈ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਰੁਤਿ ॥","translit_en":"piree milaavaa jaa theeaai saiee suhaavee rut ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Beauteous is that season, when I am united with my Beloved.","ms":"Beauteous is the season, when my union with my Beloved is effected."},"pu":{"ss":"ਉਹੀ ਰੁੱਤ ਸੋਹਣੀ ਹੈ ਜਦੋਂ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ-ਪਤੀ ਦਾ ਮੇਲ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ, ਸੋ"}}},{"verse_id":23225,"page_no":522,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਘੜੀ ਮੁਹਤੁ ਨਹ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਵੀਐ ਨਿਤ ॥੨॥","translit_en":"ghaRee muhat neh veesarai naanak raveeaai nit ||2||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"I do not forget Him for a moment or an instant; O Nanak, I contemplate Him constantly. ||2||","ms":"I forget Him not even for a moment and trice Nanak remembers Him ever."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਹਰ ਵੇਲੇ ਯਾਦ ਕਰੀਏ, ਕਦੇ ਘੜੀ ਦੋ ਘੜੀਆਂ ਭੀ ਉਹ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨਾਹ ਭੁੱਲੇ ।੨।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":1985,"next":1987}}
files.shabads/3/1987.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":1987,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":9,"page_no":522,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":8,"first_verse_id":23226,"last_verse_id":23233,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Gujri","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਗੂਜਰੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":23226,"page_no":522,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਪਉੜੀ ॥","translit_en":"pauRee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Pauree:","ms":"Pauri."}}},{"verse_id":23227,"page_no":522,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਸੂਰਬੀਰ ਵਰੀਆਮ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਹੋੜੀਐ ॥ ਫਉਜ ਸਤਾਣੀ ਹਾਠ ਪੰਚਾ ਜੋੜੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"soorabeer vareeaam kinai na hoReeaai || fauj sataanee haaTh pa(n)chaa joReeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Even brave and mighty men cannot withstand the powerful and overwhelming army which the five passions have gathered.","ms":"No brave and mighty person can withstand the powerful"},"pu":{"ss":"(ਕਾਮਾਦਿਕ ਵਿਕਾਰ) ਬੜੇ ਸੂਰਮੇ ਤੇ ਬਹਾਦਰ (ਸਿਪਾਹੀ) ਹਨ, ਕਿਸੇ ਨੇ ਇਹਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਠੱਲ੍ਹਿਆ ਨਹੀਂ, ਇਹਨਾਂ ਪੰਜਾਂ ਨੇ ਬੜੀ ਬਲ ਵਾਲੀ ਤੇ ਹਠੀਲੀ ਫ਼ੌਜ ਇਕੱਠੀ ਕੀਤੀ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ"}}},{"verse_id":23228,"page_no":522,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਦਸ ਨਾਰੀ ਅਉਧੂਤ ਦੇਨਿ ਚਮੋੜੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"dhas naaree aaudhoot dhen chamoReeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The ten organs of sensation attach even detached renunciates to sensory pleasures.","ms":"The ten organs -the five sensory and five motor - attach even the anchorites to the evil deeds."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਦੁਨੀਆਦਾਰ ਤਾਂ ਕਿਤੇ ਰਹੇ) ਤਿਆਗੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ (ਭੀ) ਇਹ ਦਸ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੇ ਚਮੋੜ ਦੇਂਦੇ ਹਨ"}}},{"verse_id":23229,"page_no":522,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਜਿਣਿ ਜਿਣਿ ਲੈਨਿੑ ਰਲਾਇ ਏਹੋ ਏਨਾ ਲੋੜੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"jin jin laini(h) ralai eho enaa loReeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"They seek to conquer and overpower them, and so increase their following.","ms":"Defeating and vanquishing the mortals they increase their following this is what they want."},"pu":{"ss":"ਸਭ ਨੂੰ ਜਿੱਤ ਜਿੱਤ ਕੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਅਨੁਸਾਰੀ ਕਰੀ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ, ਬੱਸ! ਇਹੀ ਗੱਲ ਇਹ ਲੋੜਦੇ ਹਨ, ਸਾਰੇ ਹੀ ਤੈ੍ਰਗੁਣੀ ਜੀਵ ਇਹਨਾਂ ਦੇ ਦਬਾਉ ਹੇਠ ਹਨ ।"}}},{"verse_id":23230,"page_no":522,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਤ੍ਰੈ ਗੁਣ ਇਨ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਮੋੜੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"trai gun in kai vas kinai na moReeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The world of the three dispositions is under their influence; no one can stand against them.","ms":"The men of three dispositions are under their sway and none can stand up to them."},"pu":{"ss":"ਕਿਸੇ ਨੇ ਇਹਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਮੋੜਾ ਨਹੀਂ ਪਾਇਆ, (ਮਾਇਆ ਦੀ ਖ਼ਾਤਰ ਜੀਵਾਂ ਦੀ) ਭਟਕਣਾ (ਇਹ, ਮਾਨੋ, ਇਹਨਾਂ ਪੰਜਾਂ ਦਾ) "}}},{"verse_id":23231,"page_no":522,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਭਰਮੁ ਕੋਟੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਖਾਈ ਕਹੁ ਕਿਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਤੋੜੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"bharam koT maiaa khaiee kahu kit bidh toReeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"So tell me - how can the fort of doubt and the moat of Maya be overcome?","ms":"Say, in What way can the fort of doubt and the moat of mammon be over-powered?"},"pu":{"ss":"ਕਿਲ੍ਹਾ ਹੈ ਤੇ ਮਾਇਆ (ਦਾ ਮੋਹ, ਉਸ ਕਿਲ੍ਹੇ ਦੇ ਦੁਆਲੇ ਡੂੰਘੀ) ਖਾਈ (ਪੁੱਟੀ ਹੋਈ) ਹੈ, (ਇਹ ਕਿਲ੍ਹਾ) ਕਿਵੇਂ ਤੋੜਿਆ ਜਾਏ?"}}},{"verse_id":23232,"page_no":522,"line_no":8,"gurmukhi":"ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਆਰਾਧਿ ਬਿਖਮ ਦਲੁ ਫੋੜੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"gur pooraa aaraadh bikham dhal foReeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Worshipping the Perfect Guru, this awesome force is subdued.","ms":"Contemplating on the Perfect Guru this formidable force is subdued."},"pu":{"ss":"ਪੂਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਨੂੰ ਯਾਦ ਕੀਤਿਆਂ ਇਹ ਕਰੜੀ ਫ਼ੌਜ ਸਰ ਕੀਤੀ ਜਾ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ"}}},{"verse_id":23233,"page_no":522,"line_no":8,"gurmukhi":"ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਅਗੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਰਹਾ ਕਰ ਜੋੜੀਐ ॥੧੫॥","translit_en":"hau tis agai dhin raat rahaa kar joReeaai ||15||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"I stand before Him, day and night, with my palms pressed together. ||15||","ms":"With joined hands, day and night, I remain standing before Him."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਜੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੀ ਮਿਹਰ ਹੋਵੇ ਤਾਂ) ਮੈਂ ਦਿਨ ਰਾਤ ਹੱਥ ਜੋੜ ਕੇ ਉਸ ਗੁਰੂ ਦੇ ਸਾਹਮਣੇ ਖਲੋਤਾ ਰਹਾਂ ।੧੫।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":1986,"next":1988}}

files.shabads/3/1992.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":1992,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":9,"page_no":522,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":3,"first_verse_id":23252,"last_verse_id":23254,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Gujri","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਗੂਜਰੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":23252,"page_no":522,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਮਃ ੫ ॥","translit_en":"mahalaa panjavaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Fifth Mehla:","ms":"5th Guru."}}},{"verse_id":23253,"page_no":522,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਸੁਭ ਚਿੰਤਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਰਮਣ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗ ॥","translit_en":"subh chi(n)tan gobi(n)dh raman niramal saadhoo sa(n)g ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Bless me with sublime thoughts, O Lord of the Universe, and contemplation in the immaculate Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.","ms":"O Lord of the world, bless me with sublime thoughts, Thy meditation and immaculate society of saints."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਭਗਵਾਨ! ਮੈਂ ਨਾਨਕ ਉਤੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰ ਕਿ ਮੈਂ ਇਕ ਘੜੀ ਭਰ ਭੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮ ਨਾਹ ਭੁਲਾਵਾਂ"}}},{"verse_id":23254,"page_no":522,"line_no":16,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਵਿਸਰਉ ਇਕ ਘੜੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਭਗਵੰਤ ॥੨॥","translit_en":"naanak naam na visarau ik ghaRee kar kirapaa bhagava(n)t ||2||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O Nanak, may I never forget the Naam, the Name of the Lord, for even an instant; be merciful to me, Lord God. ||2||","ms":"O Auspicious Master, show mercy unto Nanak, that he may not forget Thee even for a moment."},"pu":{"ss":"ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰ ਸਤ-ਸੰਗ ਕਰਾਂ, ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਦਾ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਕਰਾਂ ਤੇ ਭਲੀਆਂ ਸੋਚਾਂ ਸੋਚਾਂ ।੨।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":1991,"next":1993}}
files.shabads/3/1993.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":1993,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":9,"page_no":522,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":9,"first_verse_id":23255,"last_verse_id":23263,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Gujri","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਗੂਜਰੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":23255,"page_no":522,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਪਉੜੀ ॥","translit_en":"pauRee ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Pauree:","ms":"Pauri."}}},{"verse_id":23256,"page_no":522,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਹੋਇ ਤ ਕਾਹੇ ਡਰਪੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"teraa keetaa hoi ta kaahe ddarapeeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Whatever happens is according to Your Will, so why should I be afraid?","ms":"When everything is done by Thee, why should I, then, feel fear?"},"pu":{"ss":"ਜੇ (ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ!) ਜੋ ਕੁਝ ਵਾਪਰਦਾ ਹੈ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੀ ਕੀਤਾ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ ਤਾਂ (ਅਸੀ) ਕਿਉਂ (ਕਿਸੇ ਤੋਂ) ਡਰੀਏ? "}}},{"verse_id":23257,"page_no":522,"line_no":17,"gurmukhi":"ਜਿਸੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਨਾਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਜੀਉ ਅਰਪੀਐ ॥","translit_en":"jis mil japeeaai naau tis jeeau arapeeaai ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Meeting Him, I meditate on the Name - I offer my soul to Him.","ms":"By meeting whom, the Name is remembered, Unto him tender thou thy soul."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਸ ਨੂੰ ਮਿਲ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ ਜਪਿਆ ਜਾਏ, ਉਸ ਅਗੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪ ਭੇਟਾ ਕਰ ਦੇਣਾ ਚਾਹੀਦਾ ਹੈ"}}},{"verse_id":23258,"page_no":522,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਆਇਐ ਚਿਤਿ ਨਿਹਾਲੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਬੇਸੁਮਾਰ ॥","translit_en":"aaiaai chit nihaal saahib besumaar ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"When the Infinite Lord comes to mind, one is enraptured.","ms":"By recollecting in the mind, the Infinite Lord, the mortal is enraptured."},"pu":{"ss":"ਕਿਉਂਕਿ ਜੇ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਚਿੱਤ ਵਿਚ ਆ ਵੱਸੇ ਤਾਂ ਨਿਹਾਲ ਹੋ ਜਾਈਦਾ ਹੈ"}}},{"verse_id":23259,"page_no":522,"line_no":18,"gurmukhi":"ਤਿਸ ਨੋ ਪੋਹੇ ਕਵਣੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਵਲਿ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ॥","translit_en":"tis no pohe kavan jis val nira(n)kaar ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Who can touch one who has the Formless Lord on his side?","ms":"Who can touch him, on whose side is the Formless Lord?"},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਸ ਦੇ ਪੱਖ ਤੇ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਹੋ ਜਾਏ, ਉਸ ਤੇ ਕੋਈ ਦਬਾ ਨਹੀਂ ਪਾ ਸਕਦਾ"}}},{"verse_id":23260,"page_no":522,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਬਾਹਰਾ ॥","translit_en":"sabh kichh tis kai vas na koiee baaharaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Everything is under His control; no one is beyond Him.","ms":"All are subject to His sway. None is beyond His pale."},"pu":{"ss":"ਕਿਉਂਕਿ ਹਰੇਕ ਚੀਜ਼ ਉਸ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਦੇ ਵੱਸ ਵਿਚ ਹੈ, ਉਸ ਦੇ ਹੁਕਮ ਤੋਂ ਪਰੇ ਨਹੀਂ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ"}}},{"verse_id":23261,"page_no":522,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਸੋ ਭਗਤਾ ਮਨਿ ਵੁਠਾ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਹਰਾ ॥","translit_en":"so bhagataa man vuThaa sach samaaharaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"He, the True Lord, dwells in the minds of His devotees.","ms":"He, the joyful True Lord, abides in the mind of His devoted slaves."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਭਗਤਾਂ ਦੇ) ਸਿਮਰਨ ਕਰ ਕੇ ਉਹ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਭਗਤਾਂ ਦੇ ਮਨ ਵਿਚ ਆ ਵੱਸਦਾ ਹੈ (ਉਹਨਾਂ ਦੇ ਅੰਦਰ) ਸਮਾ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ ।"}}},{"verse_id":23262,"page_no":522,"line_no":19,"gurmukhi":"ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਸ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਤੂੰ ਰਖਣ ਵਾਲਿਆ ॥","translit_en":"tere dhaas dhiaain tudh too(n) rakhan vaaliaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Your slaves meditate on You; You are the Savior, the Protector Lord.","ms":"Thine serfs contemplate on Thee alone, O Thou the Saviour."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ! ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਸ ਤੈਨੂੰ ਯਾਦ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਨ, ਤੂੰ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਦੀ ਰੱਖਿਆ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈਂ"}}},{"verse_id":23263,"page_no":523,"line_no":1,"gurmukhi":"ਸਿਰਿ ਸਭਨਾ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿਆ ॥੧੭॥","translit_en":"sir sabhanaa samarath nadhar nihaaliaa ||17||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"You are the Almighty Overlord of all; You bless us with Your Glance of Grace. ||17||","ms":"Thou art the Omnipotent Over Lord of all and through Thine grace all are blessed."},"pu":{"ss":"ਤੂੰ ਸਭ ਜੀਵਾਂ ਦੇ ਸਿਰ ਤੇ ਹਾਕਮ ਹੈਂ, ਮੇਹਰ ਦੀ ਨਜ਼ਰ ਕਰ ਕੇ (ਜੀਵਾਂ ਨੂੰ) ਸੁਖ ਦੇਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੈਂ ।੧।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":1992,"next":1994}}

(ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਤੋਂ) ਸਦਾ ਸਦਕੇ ਹੋ (ਤੇ ਇਉਂ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਕਰ—) ਹੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ! ਰੱਖਿਆ ਕਰ ਤੇ (ਮੇਰੇ ਅੰਦਰੋਂ) ਕਾਮ, ਕੋ੍ਰਧ, ਲੋਭ, ਮੋਹ, ਅਹੰਕਾਰ"}}},{"verse_id":23266,"page_no":523,"line_no":2,"gurmukhi":"ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਪਣੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿ ॥੧॥","translit_en":"raakh leh prabh aapane naanak sadh balihaar ||1||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Protect me, O my God; Nanak is forever a sacrifice to You. ||1||","ms":"Protect me, O My Lord, Nanak is ever a sacrifice unto Thee."},"pu":{"ss":"ਦੀ ਮਸਤੀ ਤੇ ਭੈੜੀਆਂ ਵਾਸ਼ਨਾ ਦੂਰ ਕਰ ।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":1993,"next":1995}}
files.shabads/3/1995.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":1995,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":9,"page_no":523,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":3,"first_verse_id":23267,"last_verse_id":23269,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Gujri","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਗੂਜਰੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":23267,"page_no":523,"line_no":2,"gurmukhi":"ਮਃ ੫ ॥","translit_en":"mahalaa panjavaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Fifth Mehla:","ms":"5th Guru."}}},{"verse_id":23268,"page_no":523,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਖਾਂਦਿਆ ਖਾਂਦਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਘਠਾ ਪੈਨੰਦਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਅੰਗੁ ॥","translit_en":"khaa(n)dhiaa khaa(n)dhiaa muh ghaThaa paina(n)dhiaa sabh a(n)g ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By eating and eating, the mouth is worn out; by wearing clothes, the limbs grow weary.","ms":"By continuously eating, the mouth is worn out and by wearing, are tired all the limbs."},"pu":{"ss":"(ਮਿੱਠੇ ਪਦਾਰਥ) ਖਾਂਦਿਆਂ ਖਾਂਦਿਆਂ ਮੂੰਹ (ਭੀ) ਘਸ ਗਿਆ (ਤੇ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਕੱਪੜੇ) ਪਹਿਨਦਿਆਂ ਸਾਰਾ ਸਰੀਰ ਹੀ ਲਿੱਸਾ ਹੋ ਗਿਆ (ਭਾਵ, ਜੇ ਖਾਣ ਤੇ ਪਹਿਨਣ ਦੇ ਆਹਰਾਂ ਵਿਚ ਹੀ ਜਵਾਨੀ ਲੰਘ ਕੇ ਬੁਢੇਪਾ ਆ ਗਿਆ, ਤੇ ਫਿਰ ਭੀ)"}}},{"verse_id":23269,"page_no":523,"line_no":3,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਨਕ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਤਿਨਾ ਦਾ ਜੀਵਿਆ ਜਿਨ ਸਚਿ ਨ ਲਗੋ ਰੰਗੁ ॥੨॥","translit_en":"naanak dhirag tinaa dhaa jeeviaa jin sach na lago ra(n)g ||2||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O Nanak, cursed are the lives of those who are not attuned to the Love of the True Lord. ||2||","ms":"Accursed is the life of those, O Nanak, who are imbued not with the True Lord's love."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਮਨੁੱਖਾਂ ਦਾ ਪਿਆਰ ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਵਿਚ ਨਾਹ ਬਣਿਆ, ਉਹਨਾਂ ਦਾ ਜੀਊਣਾ ਫਿਟਕਾਰ-ਜੋਗ ਹੈ ।੨।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":1994,"next":1996}}

ਜਗਤ ਵਿਚ) ਉਸੇ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਹੈ ਜਿਵੇਂ ਤੇਰਾ ਹੁਕਮ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ"}}},{"verse_id":23272,"page_no":523,"line_no":4,"gurmukhi":"ਜਹ ਜਹ ਰਖਹਿ ਆਪਿ ਤਹ ਜਾਇ ਖੜੋਵਣਾ ॥","translit_en":"jeh jeh rakheh aap teh jai khaRovanaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Wherever You keep me, there I go and stand.","ms":"Wheresoever Thou Thyself keepst me, there I go and stand."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਥੇ ਜਿਥੇ ਤੂੰ ਆਪ (ਜੀਵਾਂ ਨੂੰ) ਰੱਖਦਾ ਹੈਂ, ਓਥੇ ਹੀ (ਜੀਵ) ਜਾ ਖਲੋਂਦੇ ਹਨ"}}},{"verse_id":23273,"page_no":523,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਮ ਤੇਰੈ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਧੋਵਣਾ ॥","translit_en":"naam terai kai ra(n)g dhuramat dhovanaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"With the Love of Your Name, I wash away my evil-mindedness.","ms":"With the love of Thy Name, I wash off my evil intellect."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜੋ ਜੀਵ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਦੇ ਪਿਆਰ ਵਿਚ (ਰਹਿੰਦੇ) ਹਨ ਉਹ ਭੈੜੀ ਮੱਤ ਧੋ ਲੈਂਦੇ ਹਨ"}}},{"verse_id":23274,"page_no":523,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਤੁਧੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਭਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਖੋਵਣਾ ॥","translit_en":"jap jap tudh nira(n)kaar bharam bhau khovanaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"By continually meditating on You, O Formless Lord, my doubts and fears are dispelled.","ms":"By continuously meditating on Thee, O formless Lord, my doubt and dread are dispelled."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ! ਤੈਨੂੰ ਸਿਮਰ ਸਿਮਰ ਕੇ ਭਟਕਣਾ ਤੇ ਡਰ ਦੂਰ ਕਰ ਲੈਂਦੇ ਹਨ ।"}}},{"verse_id":23275,"page_no":523,"line_no":5,"gurmukhi":"ਜੋ ਤੇਰੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਸੇ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਜੋਵਣਾ ॥","translit_en":"jo terai ra(n)g rate se jon na jovanaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those who are attuned to Your Love, shall not be trapped in reincarnation.","ms":"They, who are imbued with Thine affection are not yoked to existences."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜੋ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਤੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰ ਵਿਚ ਰੰਗੇ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ ਉਹ ਜੂਨਾਂ ਵਿਚ ਨਹੀਂ ਪਾਏ ਜਾਂਦੇ"}}},{"verse_id":23276,"page_no":523,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਇਕੁ ਨੈਣ ਅਲੋਵਣਾ ॥","translit_en":"a(n)tar baahar ik nain alovanaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Inwardly and outwardly, they behold the One Lord with their eyes.","ms":"Within and without, they see the one Lord with their eyes."},"pu":{"ss":"ਅੰਦਰ ਬਾਹਰ (ਹਰ ਥਾਂ) ਉਹ ਇਕ (ਤੈਨੂੰ ਹੀ) ਅੱਖਾਂ ਨਾਲ ਵੇਖਦੇ ਹਨ ।"}}},{"verse_id":23277,"page_no":523,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਜਿਨੑੀ ਪਛਾਤਾ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਤਿਨੑ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਰੋਵਣਾ ॥","translit_en":"jin(h)ee pachhaataa hukam tin(h) kadhe na rovanaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those who recognize the Lord's Command never weep.","ms":"They, who recognise Lord's will, weep not ever."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਾ ਹੁਕਮ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਹੈ ਉਹ ਕਦੇ ਪਛੁਤਾਂਦੇ ਨਹੀਂ (ਕਿਉਂਕਿ ਉਹ ਕਿਸੇ ਵਿਕਾਰ ਵਿਚ ਫਸਦੇ ਹੀ ਨਹੀਂ, ਸਗੋਂ) "}}},{"verse_id":23278,"page_no":523,"line_no":6,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਖਸੀਸ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ਪਰੋਵਣਾ ॥੧੮॥","translit_en":"naau naanak bakhasees man maeh parovanaa ||18||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O Nanak, they are blessed with the gift of the Name, woven into the fabric of their minds. ||18||","ms":"Nanak, they attain the Name's gift, which they string into their mind."},"pu":{"ss":"ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ-ਰੂਪ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ੀਸ਼ (ਸਦਾ ਆਪਣੇ) ਮਨ ਵਿਚ ਪਰੋਈ ਰੱਖਦੇ ਹਨ ।੧੮।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":1995,"next":1997}}
files.shabads/3/1997.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":1997,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":9,"page_no":523,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":3,"first_verse_id":23279,"last_verse_id":23281,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Gujri","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਗੂਜਰੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":23279,"page_no":523,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੫ ॥","translit_en":"salok mahalaa panjavaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Shalok, Fifth Mehla:","ms":"Slok 5th Guru."}}},{"verse_id":23280,"page_no":523,"line_no":7,"gurmukhi":"ਜੀਵਦਿਆ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਮੁਆ ਰਲੰਦੜੋ ਖਾਕ ॥","translit_en":"jeevadhiaa na chetio muaa rala(n)dhaRo khaak ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Those who do not remember the Lord while they are alive, shall mix with the dust when they die.","ms":"He, who, while living, remembers not the Lord, on dying he mixes with the dust."},"pu":{"ss":"ਜਿਤਨਾ ਚਿਰ ਜੀਊਂਦਾ ਰਿਹਾ ਰੱਬ ਨੂੰ ਯਾਦ ਨਾਹ ਕੀਤਾ, ਮਰ ਗਿਆ ਤਾਂ ਮਿੱਟੀ ਵਿਚ ਰਲ ਗਿਆ"}}},{"verse_id":23281,"page_no":523,"line_no":8,"gurmukhi":"ਨਾਨਕ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਸੰਗਿ ਗੁਦਾਰਿਆ ਸਾਕਤ ਮੂੜ ਨਪਾਕ ॥੧॥","translit_en":"naanak dhuneeaa sa(n)g gudhaariaa saakat mooR napaak ||1||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"O Nanak, the foolish and filthy faithless cynic passes his life engrossed in the world. ||1||","ms":"The foolish and filthy mammon worshipper, O Nanak, passes his life engrossed with the world."},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਰੱਬ ਨਾਲੋਂ ਟੁੱਟੇ ਹੋਏ ਐਸੇ ਮੂਰਖ ਗੰਦੇ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਨੇ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਨਾਲ ਹੀ (ਜੀਵਨ ਅਜਾਈਂ) ਗੁਜ਼ਾਰ ਦਿੱਤਾ ।੧।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":1996,"next":1998}}
files.shabads/3/1998.json: {"shabad":{"shabad_id":1998,"source_id":"G","writer_id":null,"raag_id":9,"page_no":523,"shabad_name":null,"verse_count":3,"first_verse_id":23282,"last_verse_id":23284,"source_english":"Sri Guru Granth Sahib Ji","source_unicode":"ਸ੍ਰੀ ਗੁਰੂ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਜੀ","writer":null,"writer_unicode":null,"raag":"Raag Gujri","raag_unicode":"ਰਾਗੁ ਗੂਜਰੀ"},"verses":[{"verse_id":23282,"page_no":523,"line_no":8,"gurmukhi":"ਮਃ ੫ ॥","translit_en":"mahalaa panjavaa ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"Fifth Mehla:","ms":"5th Guru."}}},{"verse_id":23283,"page_no":523,"line_no":8,"gurmukhi":"ਜੀਵੰਦਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਚੇਤਿਆ ਮਰੰਦਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ॥","translit_en":"jeeva(n)dhiaa har chetiaa mara(n)dhiaa har ra(n)g ||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"One who remembers the Lord while he is alive, shall be imbued with the Lord's Love when he dies.","ms":"He, who in life, meditates on God and associates with the society of saints and on dying gets imbued with God's love,"},"pu":{"ss":"ਹੇ ਨਾਨਕ! ਜਿਸ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਨੇ ਸਤ ਸੰਗ ਵਿਚ (ਰਹਿ ਕੇ) ਜੀਊਂਦਿਆਂ (ਸਾਰੀ ਉਮਰ) ਪਰਮਾਤਮਾ ਨੂੰ ਯਾਦ ਰੱਖਿਆ, ਤੇ ਮਰਨ ਵੇਲੇ ਭੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੇ ਪਿਆਰ ਵਿਚ ਰਿਹਾ"}}},{"verse_id":23284,"page_no":523,"line_no":9,"gurmukhi":"ਜਨਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਤਾਰਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ॥੨॥","translit_en":"janam padhaarath taariaa naanak saadhoo sa(n)g ||2||","translation":{"en":{"bdb":"The precious gift of his life is redeemed, O Nanak, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||2||","ms":"O Nanak, he makes fruitful his precious human life."},"pu":{"ss":"ਉਸ ਨੇ ਇਹ ਮਨੁੱਖਾ ਜੀਵਨ-ਰੂਪ ਅਮੋਲਕ ਚੀਜ਼ (ਸੰਸਾਰ-ਸਮੰੁਦਰ ਵਿਚ ਰੁੜ੍ਹਨੋਂ) ਬਚਾ ਲਈ ਹੈ ।੨।"}}}],"nav":{"prev":1997,"next":1999}}
